title: B8.4 synthetic submissions: manifest (PROVISIONAL)
description: Index of the B8.4 test set (PRD B8): the rubrics (marking tables, PRD B1.3) the submissions are written against, and one entry per submission. PROVISIONAL: the format is a Release 0 proposal by Student 3 and is not yet agreed by the other contract owners or the guide (see the set's README, open decisions).
$comment: Cross-file rules (ids unique, rubric and submission references resolve, folders exist, marking tables parse, expected outcomes agree with the files) are not expressible here and are checked by libs/contracts/tests/test_b8_4_dataset.py.

status.description: provisional until B8.2 is merged, Q32 is resolved and the format is agreed.

repo_path.description: Path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes and no '..' segment.

course_package.description: The course.yaml that defines the assignment and its points.

task_body.description: The assignment body holding the task text (the question) and its marking table (the rubric).

learner_ref.description: Fictional placeholder. Never a name, email, LTI sub or Moodle id.

intended_level.description: What the author wrote the submission to be. Not a grade: reference grades come only from a mentor.

ambiguous.description: True when a reasonable mentor could judge at least one criterion either way.

split.description: unassigned until the guide decides the split (design Q47).
